contributions.basis: cover-line1-cumulative (over-$50 subset) + cover-line2 (the filer ALSO itemised his sub-$50 contributions on Form A)
contributions.detail: All 6 Form A rows sum to 4,489.00 = cover line1 + line2 (4,400.00 + 89.00), because this filer itemised the $50-or-less contributions on Form A as well as the over-$50 ones. The decomposition closes EXACTLY on both cover lines independently: the 3 rows above $50 (100.00 + 300.00 + 4,000.00) = 4,400.00 = cover line 1; the 3 rows at or below $50 (20.00 + 20.00 + 49.00) = 89.00 = cover line 2. Per the addendum the scored basis is line 1 alone. THE FILER LEFT THE WHOLE 'TOTALS FOR THIS REPORT' COLUMN BLANK and wrote every figure only in 'CUMULATIVE REPORT', with a slashed-zero nil glyph in 'TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT' - so the rows are unambiguously on the CUMULATIVE scope and the THIS cells are recorded as '' (field exists, filer left it blank), not null. Corroborating but NOT an anchor: the filer left an unlabelled pencil calculation floating in the blank part of the sheet reading '$4489.00 / 4400.00' - his own version of exactly this decomposition. It is not a form field and was not transcribed as a row.
contributions.sub50_itemized_note: SUB-$50 TRAP INVERSION, same shape as the Gleed filing in this chunk: scoring Form A against line 1 alone would show an 89.00 overage, and scoring against line1+line2 closes exactly. Both figures are reported above so a downstream consumer can pick either scope.

expenditures.detail: 20 Form B rows sum to exactly 14,072.69 = cover line 3 CUMULATIVE (the THIS cell is blank, as on every line of this cover). The close required ONE arithmetic reversal on line 9 - see that row's note. Corroborating but NOT an anchor: an unlabelled hand-written '$14072.69' floats in the blank lower part of the sheet, the filer's own scratch total; the Carr form prints no schedule total field, so it was not treated as one.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr 5-5-PG prints NO page subtotal or schedule total; gates run against the cover. p2 rows 4,489.00 = cover line1+line2 4,489.00 (and the over-$50 subset 4,400.00 = line 1 exactly). p3 rows 14,072.69 = cover line 3 14,072.69 (exact).
gates.row_count: Ink-profile scan of the amount column (x 80-98%) at 200 dpi, with the fax header band at ypx 15-42 and the printed 'Amount' heading discounted. p2: 6 inked amount bands between ypx 276 and 556 and nothing below except the filer's floating scratch calculation at ypx 847-932 -> 6 rows, 6 emitted. p3: 20 inked amount rows between ypx 265 and 1332 (four band-pairs merged: rows 4-5, 8-9, 11-12, 17-18) and nothing below except the floating scratch total at ypx 1562-1604 -> 20 rows, 20 emitted. Both floating figures are unlabelled scratch marks in blank space, not fields, and were NOT emitted as rows.
gates.geometry_proof: p2 first-row crop (600dpi, pct 80.00,12.55,17.00,1.64) renders '$20.00'; last-row crop (pct 80.00,23.68,17.00,1.59) renders '$4000.00'; control one row-pitch below renders EMPTY. p3 first-row crop (pct 80.00,12.05,17.00,1.86) renders '$74.09'; last-row crop (pct 80.00,58.86,17.00,1.68) renders '$268.22'; control one pitch below renders EMPTY.
gates.balance_chain: WOULD NOT CLOSE, and that is the filer's own state, not a transcription gap: cover line 4 (balance at end of period) is left BLANK in both the THIS and the CUMULATIVE cells, with only a slashed-zero nil glyph in the LAST column. The cover's own figures imply 0 + 4,400.00 + 89.00 - 14,072.69 = -9,583.69, which the filer did not write anywhere. No balance figure is therefore claimed. No earlier filing by this filer in this chunk, so no cross-filing cumulative chain check was possible.

escalation_note: THIS IS A FAXED FILING (every page carries an 'OCT/28/2014/TUE 02:04 PM FAX No. P.00n' header), the degradation mode the cache addendum warns about. The whole p3 amount column was re-rendered at 1200 dpi in four slices - that is what caught line 9 (1,280.00 at 200 dpi vs 1,250.00 at 1200 dpi, resolved to 1,250.00 because the schedule then closes on the cover exactly). The whole p2 amount column was re-rendered at 1200 dpi in one slice, settling line 6 as 4,000.00 over an overstrike. Plus 600 dpi + -normalize on the cover anchor block and six 600 dpi geometry-proof crops.
notes: index.csv says candidate 'Pitcher', office 'Treasurer'; the cover reads 'Full Name of Candidate: Tyler John Pitcher', 'Name of Office: Treasurer', 'Office District: Cache County' - AGREES, county office, in scope. Political Party Republican; the filer dated the form 10/28/14, the fax header reads OCT/28/2014 02:04 PM and the clerk stamped it RCVD 28 OCT 2014. THREE Form A rows name the donor only as 'Anonymous' with the address cell left empty - transcribed verbatim; that is what the filer wrote, and an empty address cell here is the filer leaving it blank, NOT a redaction. One row carries an explicit written 'In Kind Contribution' label and is the only row in this whole chunk with in_kind set true; another is labelled 'LOAN Contribution', which is recorded in the row note rather than in donor_raw. Both schedules carry an unlabelled floating scratch figure in blank space (p2 '$4489.00 / 4400.00', p3 '$14072.69'); neither is a form field and neither was transcribed as a row, but both corroborate the reconciliation. Street addresses, ZIPs, the candidate's home address and home phone are printed in the clear and were discarded at read time.

expenditures.note: THE ARITHMETIC REVERSAL ON THIS FILING. A 200 dpi read of this faxed page gave 1,280.00 and left the schedule 30.00 OVER the cover. At 1200 dpi the third digit is an unambiguous 5, and 1,250.00 makes the schedule close on cover line 3 EXACTLY. The form's own arithmetic decided it - the exact failure mode the cache addendum warns about on faxed Carr pages.
